usedFor: Zoho Zeptomail sends transactional emails and HubSpot holds contacts, so suppression events can update a contact through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a suppression entry (email or domain) is created or updated” in Zoho Zeptomail, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A suppressed address can be shown on the contact record, so nobody keeps writing to a dead address.

watchOut: Suppression entries are polling and also fire on updates, so “Update Contact” can run twice for one address.
